Hillgrove Hawk Pop
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#090909">
<title>HAWKPOP 500-Pop Pilot | Hillgrove Foundation</title>
<style>
:root {
  --black:#090909;
  --black2:#151515;
  --red:#f2c400;
  --red2:#ffd21a;
  --white:#ffffff;
  --soft:#f6f6f6;
  --muted:#686868;
  --line:#e5e5e5;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:#efefef;
  color:#111;
  font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  line-height:1.5;
}
.page{
  width:min(1100px,100%);
  margin:0 auto;
  background:#fff;
  min-height:100vh;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}
.hero{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(330px,.85fr);
  align-items:stretch;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#070707 0%,#151515 72%,#21090b 100%);
  color:#fff;
  min-height:500px;
}
.hero-copy{
  padding:48px 24px 46px 50px;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:center;
}
.kicker{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-self:flex-start;
  padding:7px 11px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#fff;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
h1{
  margin:0;
  font-size:clamp(48px,7vw,82px);
  line-height:.92;
  letter-spacing:-.055em;
}
h1 span{color:var(--red2)}
.subtitle{
  max-width:650px;
  margin:18px 0 0;
  font-size:20px;
  color:#f2f2f2;
}
.origin{
  max-width:660px;
  margin:20px 0 0;
  color:#cfcfcf;
  font-size:15px;
}
.hero-image{
  min-width:0;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  padding:14px 24px 14px 0;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-image img{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  max-width:520px;
  height:500px;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center;
  border-radius:0;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 24px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.44));
}

.metrics{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:14px;
  padding:22px 46px;
  background:#fafafa;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.metric{
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:18px 20px;
  text-align:center;
  background:#fff;
}
.metric.primary{
  background:var(--red);
  border-color:var(--red);
  color:#111;
}
.metric .big{
  font-size:35px;
  line-height:1;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.04em;
}
.metric .label{
  margin-top:7px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.05em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);
}
.metric.primary .label{color:#111}

.content{
  padding:36px 46px 48px;
}
.intro{
  margin:0;
  font-size:18px;
}
.section-title{
  margin:32px 0 14px;
  font-size:24px;
  line-height:1.15;
  letter-spacing:-.025em;
}
.grid-2{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:18px;
}
.card{
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:22px;
  background:#fff;
}
.card h3{
  margin:0 0 13px;
  font-size:18px;
}
.row{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:18px;
  padding:10px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #ededed;
}
.row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.row strong{white-space:nowrap}
.fdn{color:#a77400;font-weight:900}

.activation{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:14px;
}
.step{
  min-height:180px;
  padding:20px;
  border-radius:16px;
  background:#111;
  color:#fff;
}
.step .num{
  color:#ffd21a;
  font-weight:900;
  font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:.09em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.step h3{
  margin:8px 0 8px;
  font-size:20px;
}
.step p{
  margin:0;
  color:#d6d6d6;
  font-size:14px;
}

.distribution{
  margin-top:14px;
  border:2px solid #151515;
  border-radius:18px;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.distribution-head{
  padding:18px 22px;
  background:#111;
  color:#fff;
}
.distribution-head h3{
  margin:0;
  font-size:21px;
}
.distribution-head p{
  margin:5px 0 0;
  color:#d7d7d7;
  font-size:14px;
}
.terms{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
  gap:0;
}
.term{
  padding:20px 22px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);
}
.term:nth-child(odd){
  border-right:1px solid var(--line);
}
.term strong{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  font-size:15px;
}
.term p{
  margin:0;
  color:#555;
  font-size:14px;
}

.why{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
  gap:10px 18px;
}
.why div{
  padding:11px 13px;
  background:#fafafa;
  border-left:4px solid var(--red);
  font-weight:700;
}

.cta{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:20px;
  margin-top:34px;
  padding:24px 26px;
  border-radius:18px;
  background:var(--red);
  color:#111;
}
.cta h2{
  margin:0 0 5px;
  font-size:26px;
}
.cta p{
  max-width:670px;
  margin:0;
}
.badge{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  padding:12px 15px;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#050505;
  color:#fff;
  font-weight:900;
  text-align:center;
}

.footer{
  padding:18px 30px 30px;
  color:#777;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:12px;
}

@media(max-width:800px){
  .hero{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    min-height:0;
  }
  .hero-copy{
    padding:34px 24px 22px;
  }
  .hero-image{
    padding:6px 24px 30px;
  }
  .hero-image img{
    width:min(100%,390px);
    height:auto;
    max-height:500px;
  }
  .metrics{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    padding:18px 24px;
  }
  .content{
    padding:28px 24px 38px;
  }
  .grid-2,.activation,.why,.terms{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }
  .term:nth-child(odd){
    border-right:0;
  }
  .cta{
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .badge{
    width:100%;
  }
}

@media print{
  body{background:#fff}
  .page{box-shadow:none;width:100%}
  .hero{min-height:430px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main class="page">

  <header class="hero">
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <div class="kicker">Hillgrove Foundation • 500-Pop Pilot</div>
      <h1>Meet <span>HAWKPOP.</span></h1>
      <p class="subtitle">A Hillgrove-branded frozen pop fundraiser designed to create student excitement, hands-on learning and new revenue—with no upfront inventory cost to the Foundation.</p>
      <p class="origin"><strong>MOKIPOPS</strong> is a local popsicle manufacturer that has been in business for 12 years. The company was started by three young siblings. <strong>Two of the founders are current Hillgrove students, and one is a recent Hillgrove graduate.</strong></p>
    </div>

    <div class="hero-image">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="HAWKPOP Hillgrove branded frozen pop">
    </div>
  </header>

  <section class="metrics">
    <div class="metric primary">
      <div class="big">$0</div>
      <div class="label">Upfront inventory cost</div>
    </div>
    <div class="metric">
      <div class="big">$825</div>
      <div class="label">Potential Foundation proceeds</div>
    </div>
    <div class="metric">
      <div class="big">$50</div>
      <div class="label">Potential student club proceeds</div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="content">
    <p class="intro"><strong>The proposal:</strong> MOKIPOPS will produce and provide the first <strong>500 custom-branded HAWKPOPS</strong> for a Hillgrove event. The Foundation carries no upfront inventory expense for this pilot.</p>

    <div class="grid-2">
      <div class="card">
        <h3>500-Pop Financial Model</h3>
        <div class="row"><span>Retail price</span><strong>$4.00 / pop</strong></div>
        <div class="row"><span>MOKIPOPS share</span><strong>$2.25 / pop</strong></div>
        <div class="row"><span>Hillgrove gross share</span><strong class="fdn">$1.75 / pop</strong></div>
        <div class="row"><span>Student club allocation</span><strong>$0.10 / pop</strong></div>
      </div>

      <div class="card">
        <h3>If All 500 Sell</h3>
        <div class="row"><span>Total sales</span><strong>$2,000</strong></div>
        <div class="row"><span>MOKIPOPS</span><strong>$1,125</strong></div>
        <div class="row"><span>Hillgrove Foundation</span><strong class="fdn">$825</strong></div>
        <div class="row"><span>Participating student organization</span><strong>$50</strong></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <h2 class="section-title">Student-Led Launch</h2>
    <div class="activation">
      <article class="step">
        <div class="num">01 • Build Curiosity</div>
        <h3>The Groove Show</h3>
        <p>Student challenges, giveaways, social content and HAWKPOP sightings create buzz before game day.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="step">
        <div class="num">02 • Create Demand</div>
        <h3>Game-Day Drop</h3>
        <p>HAWKPOP is positioned as a limited school-branded product available at an upcoming Hillgrove event.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="step">
        <div class="num">03 • Students Sell</div>
        <h3>FBLA / Marketing</h3>
        <p>Participating students support sales and inventory while earning funds for their organization from each pop sold.</p>
      </article>
    </div>

    <h2 class="section-title">Distribution of Funds & Pilot Inventory</h2>
    <section class="distribution">
      <div class="distribution-head">
        <h3>Simple reconciliation. Clear inventory responsibility.</h3>
        <p>The pilot is funded upfront by MOKIPOPS, with proceeds and remaining inventory reconciled immediately after the event.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="terms">
        <div class="term">
          <strong>MOKIPOPS Payment</strong>
          <p>MOKIPOPS will receive its share of pilot sales within <strong>3 business days</strong> following the event.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="term">
          <strong>Unsold HAWKPOPS</strong>
          <p>Any remaining pops will be collected by MOKIPOPS in <strong>perfect frozen, usable condition</strong>.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="term">
          <strong>Shortage or Unusable Product</strong>
          <p>Any shortage, missing inventory or pops that become unusable while in Hillgrove's custody will be the responsibility of the <strong>Hillgrove Foundation</strong> and included in final reconciliation.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="term">
          <strong>MOKIPOPS Pilot Support</strong>
          <p>MOKIPOPS can provide a team member to assist with pop handling, freezer management, inventory counts and pilot reconciliation.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <h2 class="section-title">Why Pilot HAWKPOP?</h2>
    <div class="why">
      <div>No upfront product cost to the Foundation</div>
      <div>A product created specifically for Hillgrove</div>
      <div>Direct fundraising revenue from every sale</div>
      <div>Real-world marketing and sales experience for students</div>
      <div>Built-in student media and engagement opportunity</div>
      <div>Potential recurring fundraiser for future school events</div>
    </div>

    <section class="cta">
      <div>
        <h2>Start with 500. Measure the response.</h2>
        <p>If the pilot succeeds, HAWKPOP can become a recurring fundraising product for Hillgrove athletics, concessions and other school events.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="badge">500 HAWKPOPS<br>$0 UPFRONT</div>
    </section>
  </section>

  <footer class="footer">HAWKPOP Pilot Proposal • Presented by MOKIPOPS</footer>
</main>
</body>
</html>
